_about: Curated pairings. heading/body/mono are Fontsource ids from curated.json; arabic is the matching Arabic-script face for RTL/bilingual builds (body; arabic_display optional for headings). Weights are suggestions, not limits.

pairings.name: Clean SaaS
pairings.heading: inter-tight
pairings.use: Product UI, dashboards, B2B SaaS, docs
pairings.why: One family doing everything keeps the UI quiet. Inter Tight gives headlines density without a second voice.

pairings.name: Developer Product
pairings.heading: geist
pairings.use: Dev tools, AI products, technical landing pages
pairings.why: Sans and mono drawn together, so code and prose share a rhythm.

pairings.name: Enterprise Bilingual
pairings.heading: ibm-plex-sans
pairings.use: Telecom, banking, government, enterprise decks and portals (stc, Jazz)
pairings.why: The only superfamily whose Arabic was designed to sit beside its Latin, so mixed-language lines look like one voice.

pairings.name: Fintech Trust
pairings.heading: manrope
pairings.use: Wallets, payments, insurance, eSIM/telecom checkout
pairings.why: Manrope's compact modern headings with a neutral, highly legible government-grade body face.

pairings.name: Modern Editorial
pairings.heading: instrument-serif
pairings.use: Agency sites, portfolios, premium landing pages, studios (UVerse-style)
pairings.why: Condensed serif display against a sharp grotesque: the current high-end landing-page look.

pairings.name: Magazine
pairings.heading: fraunces
pairings.use: Blogs, long reads, newsletters, publishing
pairings.why: Expressive soft display serif on a disciplined optical-size text serif.

pairings.name: Newsroom
pairings.heading: newsreader
pairings.use: News, reports, research, analytics write-ups
pairings.why: Serif headlines for authority and a news-designed grotesk for scannable body.

pairings.name: Luxury
pairings.heading: cormorant-garamond
pairings.use: Fashion, jewellery, hotels, perfume, real estate
pairings.why: Delicate high-contrast serif with a clean Futura-like geometric body; lots of air.

pairings.name: Fashion Didone
pairings.heading: bodoni-moda
pairings.use: Fashion, beauty, lookbooks
pairings.why: Magazine-cover Didone headlines over a calm Scandinavian geometric.

pairings.name: Classic Premium
pairings.heading: playfair-display
pairings.use: Law firms, consultancies, restaurants, invitations
pairings.why: Timeless contrast pairing; Source Sans keeps body copy modest.

pairings.name: Friendly Startup
pairings.heading: plus-jakarta-sans
pairings.use: Startup marketing sites, consumer SaaS, B2C apps
pairings.why: Single polished family; heavy weights carry the brand, regular stays readable.

pairings.name: Consumer Geometric
pairings.heading: outfit
pairings.use: Consumer mobile apps, lifestyle, delivery, booking
pairings.why: Round geometric headlines with a friendlier, more readable geometric body.

pairings.name: Bold Tech
pairings.heading: sora
pairings.use: Fintech, crypto, AI, hardware launches
pairings.why: Wide geometric display reads 'future'; Inter keeps the details sober.

pairings.name: Quirky Agency
pairings.heading: space-grotesk
pairings.use: Creative agencies, events, hackathons, web3
pairings.why: Space Grotesk's odd details give personality; DM Sans calms the body.

pairings.name: Expressive Display
pairings.heading: bricolage-grotesque
pairings.use: Brand campaigns, product launches, culture brands
pairings.why: Big characterful grotesque headlines over a quiet minimal body.

pairings.name: Art Gallery
pairings.heading: syne
pairings.use: Galleries, music, fashion events, portfolios
pairings.why: Syne's extreme heavy weights make posters; Work Sans is neutral at reading sizes.

pairings.name: Product Launch
pairings.heading: mona-sans
pairings.use: Launch pages, keynote-style sites, motion graphics
pairings.why: Width + weight axes let one family go from compressed hero to wide sub-heads.

pairings.name: Warm & Crafted
pairings.heading: young-serif
pairings.use: Food, cafes, bakeries, craft goods, recipes
pairings.why: Cosy heavy old-style headlines with a slightly quirky warm body.

pairings.name: Soft Retro
pairings.heading: fraunces
pairings.use: Lifestyle, wellness, kids' brands, cookbooks
pairings.why: Fraunces with SOFT/WONK turned up feels 70s; DM Sans keeps things clean.

pairings.name: Playful Rounded
pairings.heading: nunito
pairings.use: Kids, education, health, games, onboarding
pairings.why: Rounded terminals everywhere feel soft and safe.

pairings.name: Accessibility First
pairings.heading: atkinson-hyperlegible-next
pairings.use: Healthcare, government, elderly users, education
pairings.why: Every face here was designed specifically for low-vision legibility.

pairings.name: Reading App
pairings.heading: literata
pairings.use: E-readers, long-form apps, documentation for non-devs
pairings.why: Built by Google for hours of screen reading; opsz keeps headings crisp.

pairings.name: Data Dense
pairings.heading: ibm-plex-sans-condensed
pairings.use: Analytics dashboards, admin panels, tables
pairings.why: Condensed headings save width; Inter tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) align numbers.

pairings.name: Sport & Energy
pairings.heading: barlow-condensed
pairings.use: Sports, fitness, gaming, telecom promos
pairings.why: Condensed italic-feeling caps for speed; Barlow body is the same DNA.

pairings.name: Poster Impact
pairings.heading: bebas-neue
pairings.use: Promos, event posters, YouTube thumbnails, social ads
pairings.why: All-caps condensed numbers and slogans hit hard; Inter does the small print.

pairings.name: Wide & Loud
pairings.heading: unbounded
pairings.use: Gaming, web3, music, youth brands
pairings.why: Wide rounded display + compact modern body + wide mono for a consistent stretched feel.

pairings.name: Gulf Modern (Arabic-first)
pairings.heading: alexandria
pairings.use: Saudi/Gulf consumer apps and sites designed Arabic-first
pairings.why: Clean geometric Arabic that matches local app conventions; DM Sans covers Latin since Tajawal has none.

pairings.name: Gulf Friendly (Arabic-first)
pairings.heading: cairo
pairings.use: Bilingual KSA/UAE marketing sites, telecom promos
pairings.why: Cairo ships matching Arabic and Latin in one file, so there are no mismatched baselines.

pairings.name: Urdu Editorial
pairings.heading: gulzar
pairings.use: Urdu content, poetry, news, Pakistani consumer campaigns
pairings.why: Proper Nastaliq, which Urdu readers expect for reading; Naskh feels foreign for Urdu long-form.

pairings.name: Urdu App UI
pairings.heading: vazirmatn
pairings.use: Urdu/English app interfaces where Nastaliq is too tall for buttons and lists (TonePerks, Jazz)
pairings.why: Naskh-style UI keeps controls compact; save Nastaliq for headlines and longer Urdu text.
